items.name: Panipat refinery capacity expansion (15 to 25 mmtpa)
items.claim: Approved in 2021, the refinery expansion in Haryana's Panipat is set to increase its 15 million metric tonnes per annum capacity to 25 mmtpa, at a total approved cost of $4.5 billion; nearly 84 per cent of the project has been completed.
items.source_excerpt: Approved in 2021, the refinery expansion in Haryana’s Panipat is set to increase its 15 million metric tonnes per annum (mmtpa) capacity to 25 mmtpa, at a total approved cost of $4.5 billion. Nearly 84 per cent of the project has been completed at Panipat, which is IOCL’s largest, alongside the one at Paradip in Odisha.

items.name: Paradip refinery para-xylene (PX) and purified terephthalic acid (PTA) plant
items.claim: The company's ongoing project to set up a para-xylene (PXA) and purified terephthalic acid (PTA) plant at the Paradip refinery is slated to be completed by April 2026, with a total cost of $1.63 billion; nearly 89 per cent of the work is completed.
items.source_excerpt: The company's ongoing project to set up a para-xylene (PXA) and purified terephthalic acid (PTA) plant at the Paradip refinery is slated to be completed by April 2026, with a total cost of $1.63 billion. Nearly 89 per cent of the work is completed.

items.name: Gujarat (Vadodara) refinery petrochemical and lube integration project
items.claim: Also on the anvil is IOCL's petrochemical and lube integration project at the Gujarat refinery in Vadodara, expected to be completed by December; more than 80 per cent completed, the project envisages raising capacity to 18 mmtpa, up from 13.7 mmtpa currently, at a total cost of $2.23 billion.
items.source_excerpt: Also on the anvil is IOCL’s petrochemical and lube integration project at the Gujarat refinery in Vadodara, expected to be completed by December. More than 80 per cent completed, the project envisages raising capacity to 18 mmtpa, up from 13.7 mmtpa currently, at a total cost of $2.23 billion.

items.name: Barauni refinery expansion (Bihar)
items.claim: IOCL's leadership said the smaller-scale 3 mmtpa capacity expansion at its Barauni refinery in Bihar is due to be completed by August the following year.
items.source_excerpt: On a smaller scale, the 3 mmtpa expansion at Barauni refinery in Bihar will be completed by August next year, the company leadership said.
